cohort_policy_details: Select exact season/game_type and declared date range; retain every source-frame game in the inclusion/exclusion ledger.

Exclude an entire candidate game for quarantine/unreconstructed status, incomplete game, critical or unknown reconstruction quality, unknown outcome, flagged/incomplete row provenance, or unassigned live control.
Retain explicit administrative unassigned references when unassigned_control_events is exactly false; no source rows disappear.
Preserve all selected game rows, original possession numbers and supplied prior-global histories; never drop individual outcomes or reindex.
Selection is provisional data availability/quality, not scientific eligibility; conditional selection may bias results.
Keep context nulls explicit with fixed missing indicators; rows lacking two observed lags are excluded from the primary models at design time and counted; sensitivity S1 keeps them.
limitations: Same already-exposed 2024-25 regular-season cohort, quality policy and partitions as 2024-25-regular-retrospective-v1; only the model specification changes. Not an unused or confirmatory cohort.
Local plan saved before the first meeting-ab-v1 fit; not an authenticated preregistration.
Reconstruction and every game remain independently unvalidated; no independent audit or game-error bound is claimed.

Paired whole-game intervals condition on fitted/development-selected models and selected games, assuming independent identically distributed games; no training/selection/calendar correction or guaranteed coverage.
History is global-order: F(t-1) is usually a foul by the opposing defense. Only retrospective prediction of recorded counted defensive fouls; no call-correctness, referee-intent or causal conclusion.
Game type is not a predictor and the cohort has no playoff rows. Actual results stay in ignored local outputs; no deployment or public scientific claim.

model_specification.history: H = 1 if previous_foul_1 == 1 or previous_foul_2 == 1; H = 0 only if both are observed 0
model_specification.lag_integrity: within each game, possession numbers must be 1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps, and previous_foul_1/2 must equal the outcomes of the preceding one/two rows; lags at the first one/two rows must be null; any mismatch withholds the comparison
model_specification.missing: context numeric constant zero plus fixed missing indicators; categorical unknown sentinel; history columns never imputed and carry no missing indicator
model_specification.primary_rows: rows with both lags observed; game-start rows excluded from base_rate, context_a and history_b at design time and counted per partition; unknown outcomes are refused upstream
model_specification.selection: tune possession logloss; first grid value breaks ties; no train+tune refit
model_specification.sensitivity_s1: all rows; H = 1 if any observed lag is 1 else 0; s1_history_b adds history_incomplete = 1 if either lag is null; s1_context_a is the context design on all rows
